info.cls_ename: Master's Program in Statistics and Actuarial Science, Department of Statistics

description.describe_ch: 這門課主要的目的是介紹一些基本的知識和精算科學的觀念。主題有存活函數、危險函數、生命表、終身壽險、生死合險、定期險、年金、保費及準備金。
description.describe_eh: The main purpose of this course is to introduce some basis knowledge and the concepts of actuarial science. The topics include the survival function, the hazard function, the life table, the whole life, the endowment, the term life insurance, annuity, premium and reserve.

targets.describe_ch: 知道存活相關函數、生命表及精算數學之基本符號
targets.describe_en: To know the survival related functions, the life table, and the basic notation of actuarial science.

targets.describe_ch: 應用各種壽險、年金、保費及準備金
targets.describe_en: To apply life insurances, annuities, premiums and reserves.

textBooks.tpb_book: Dickson, David M., Mary R. Hardy and Howard R. Waters(2020)，Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks, 3rd ed, Cambridge University Press.
textBooks.tpb_book_en: Dickson, David M., Mary R. Hardy and Howard R. Waters(2020)，Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks, 3rd ed, Cambridge University Press.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en:
Cheating & Plagiarism
For those who violate this rule, the assessment will be "no points" or the course will be "no points".
During the paper-and-pencil test, you are not allowed to talk, spy on other people’s test papers, or deliberately facilitate neighbors to peep, or entrainment, plagiarism, or transmission of materials, etc. If it is discovered, the test score for the offender will be counted as zero; it is a repeat offender Those who are involved will be dealt with in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Feng Chia University Student Reward and Punishment Measures.
If there is a test substitute, both parties involved in the fraud will be dealt with in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Feng Chia University Student Reward and Punishment Regulations.
Submit original works, any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited. Those who violate this rule will be "not scored" for the assignment or "not scored" for the course, which will result in a failure in the semester grade of the course.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: 期末設計一份保單計算保費
gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: It is necessary to explain the selection of the appropriate semester grade scoring method, and explain to the learners what is the standard of passing? As the goal of students' pursuit of learning success.Feng Chia University’s semester grade scoring methods include P/F score Pass/Fail Grade, percent score Percentage Grades, and grade score Letter Grades.

Classroom interaction & Discussion Participation
Each student goes to the iLearn course discussion area every week, and responds to at least one opinion of at least 100 words on the discussion topic. Those who do not respond will deduct 5 points from their usual grades.
Before class, do your reading and writing assignments so that you are prepared to help and participate in discussions during class.
Use FCU email and iLearn to communicate with lecturers and classmates.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
• 出勤、參與項目計入課堂參與成績
  • 錯過作業繳交、錯過考試 未請假者不給於補考
  • 加分:課堂參與熱烈或是協助架設上課設備者給於加分
  • 學生生病請假需事先告知
    • 說明與錯過或遲交作業或考試有關的後果，若採紙筆測驗者，說明考試時間長度(以小時為單位)；若為作業者要設定交付時間及方式等。
    • 若學生對成績批改、核算有疑慮時，於上課時提出疑慮可得重新評分
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
您應依授課進度與內容所列之週次及節次，對本科目填寫期中、期末之課程教學回饋意見。您的參與及回饋，將幫助我改善上課技巧、課程教學內容及活動的安排，也提供開課單位的教學品質至關重要的意見。期中形成性教學評估表在第4~8週填寫；期末學生意見調查、期末課程目標學習達成情形在學期最後一個月填寫。
上課不遲到不早退
上課不准滑手機或是睡覺
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
You are expected to provide feedback on the course by filling out midterm and final course evaluation forms based on the course schedule and content listed for each week and session. Your participation and feedback will help me improve my teaching techniques, course content, and activity arrangements. It also provides essential feedback for the teaching quality of the department. Formative assessment for the midterm should be completed between the 4th and 8th weeks, while the student opinion survey and assessment of course learning objectives should be completed in the final month of the semester.

Attendance is mandatory, and punctuality is required.
Cell phones are not permitted during class, nor is sleeping.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
請益時間的說明 您可以在我約定的每週請益時間裡，我可以直接回答您的問題及討論課程內容，利用iLearn中Teams頻道、或親自到我的請益時間。如果您在課程學習上需要幫助，但因日程安排有衝突而無法出席我約定的請益時間，請先給我發送電子郵件，另外在安排預約時間。與學生交談是我工作的一大亮點 - 我期待與您交談！

學習成功聲明 您在這門課上的成功對我來說很重要。我們都以不同的方式學習，每個人有時都在掙扎。您永遠不是唯一的！如果本課程的某些方面妨礙您學習或排斥您，請盡快告訴我。我們將一起制定策略，以滿足您的需求和完成課程的要求。我還鼓勵您聯繫安排的學習助教，協助你課業學習的難處。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Consultation Time Explanation: We have scheduled weekly consultation times where you can directly ask questions or discuss course content. You can do this through the Teams channel on iLearn or by attending my consultation hours in person. If you have scheduling conflicts that prevent you from attending our agreed consultation times, please send me an email in advance, and we can arrange an alternative appointment. Interacting with students is a highlight of my work, and I look forward to engaging with you!

Statement of Learning Success: Your success in this course is important to me. We all learn in different ways, and sometimes we all struggle. Remember, you are never alone! If you encounter any difficulties or feel excluded by any aspect of the course, please let me know as soon as possible. Together, we will devise strategies to meet your needs and fulfill the course requirements. I also encourage you to reach out to the designated learning assistants for additional assistance and support with your studies.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以零分計，若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。
  • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
